name: Weetamoo (KY)
sale: Fasig-Tipton July (FTKJUL), Hip 39, Yearling — consigned by Burleson Farms, bought by Blue Bird Stables
notes: By Lexitonian out of Indian Princess, by Indian Charlie. Trainer Todd A. Pletcher. Bred by Mercedes Stables LLC. Career: 2 starts, 1-0-0, $51,404 against a $65,000 yearling buy. Debuted on the dirt at Gulfstream (5th, bumped and tired late), then romped by 9 in a conditions-restricted maiden at Keeneland (for horses that sold or RNA’d for $65,000 or less at their last auction) — a condition her own $65,000 sale price qualified her for.

log.text: Gulfstream Park, Maiden Special Weight, 1m dirt — career debut, 5th beaten 5 1/2 as the 2.30 second choice. Bumped at the break, tracked the pace four wide, tired in the stretch.

Keeneland, Maiden Special Weight, 7f dirt (restricted to $65,000-or-less sale horses) — first career win, drawing off by 9 as the 6.42 chance. Stalked three wide, took over around the turn and cruised home under a hand ride.
Status check: no workouts logged in the last 60 days as of this date — appears to be freshening/on the shelf since the April win, nothing pointing toward an imminent return.
